LESSON: POSITIVE USAGE OF MEDIA

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.1.3: Positive Usage of Media

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Positive Usage of Media. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What types of media do you use at home?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify types of media that can be used to reinforce learning
2. explain the positive use of media for Islamic character formation
3. observe Islamic ethics while using media in day-to-day life
4. appreciate media as a gift from Allah (S.W.T.) by using them appropriately

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: POSITIVE USAGE OF MEDIA
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Positive Usage of Media helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: POSITIVE USAGE OF MEDIA
Study Positive Usage of Media like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify types of media that can be used to reinforce learning

What this means
In this part you learn to identify types of media that can be used to reinforce learning. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify types of media that can be used to reinforce learning.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Positive Usage of Media” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify types of media that can be used to reinforce learning. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Explain the positive use of media for Islamic character formation

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the positive use of media for Islamic character formation. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the positive use of media for Islamic character formation.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Positive Usage of Media in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the positive use of media for Islamic character formation. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Observe Islamic ethics while using media in day-to-day life

What this means
In this part you learn to observe Islamic ethics while using media in day-to-day life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: observe Islamic ethics while using media in day-to-day life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can observe Islamic ethics while using media in day-to-day life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Appreciate media as a gift from Allah (S.W.T.) by using them appropriately

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate media as a gift from Allah (S.W.T.) by using them appropriately. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate media as a gift from Allah (S.W.T.) by using them appropriately.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Positive Usage of Media” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate media as a gift from Allah (S.W.T.) by using them appropriately. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Positive Usage of Media is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Positive Usage of Media” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify types of media that can be used to reinforce learning)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Positive Usage of Media in your own words. (skill: explain the positive use of media for Islamic character formation)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: observe Islamic ethics while using media in day-to-day life)

Example 4: Show how “Positive Usage of Media” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate media as a gift from Allah (S.W.T.) by using them appropriately)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Positive Usage of Media to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify types of media that can be used to reinforce learning.
3. Practise this skill: explain the positive use of media for Islamic character formation.
4. Practise this skill: observe Islamic ethics while using media in day-to-day life.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Positive Usage of Media from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Positive Usage of Media: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Positive Usage of Media?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What types of media do you use at home?
2. How can you use media positively?
3. How can you use media while observing Islamic teachings?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Positive Usage of Media means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify types of media that can be used to reinforce learning.
5. Be able to: explain the positive use of media for Islamic character formation.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
